AppOAuth.description: OAuth 2.0 for the first-party Bisibility apps only; other clients cannot obtain these scopes. Use the authorization code flow with PKCE (S256) and no client secret, and do not send a `resource` parameter: `/api/v1` accepts only the opaque access tokens issued without one. Access tokens expire after 15 minutes. Refresh tokens rotate on every use, and replaying a used refresh token revokes the whole grant. To sign out, POST the refresh token with `token_type_hint=refresh_token` and the `client_id` to `/api/auth/oauth2/revoke`. Account deletion additionally requires a sign-in from the last 10 minutes (authorize again with `prompt=login`); otherwise it fails with 403 and `details.code` `reauthentication_required`. Admin operations are not available to app tokens.
